description: This file defines a controller class 'Subscription' within the OpenCart platform, responsible for handling subscription-related email notifications and alerts. It includes methods for processing subscription notifications, order alerts, and preparing email data related to subscriptions in the e-commerce system.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class handling email notifications related to subscriptions in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the process of sending subscription-related emails, including fetching subscription details, order info, constructing email content, and sending notification emails.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Handles order status change alerts, including composing and queuing email notifications to inform customers about order updates.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to process subscription email notifications based on subscription data, order details, and configuration, to be triggered upon subscription events.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Method to send order status change alert emails to customers, based on order updates.
